The '''Hinda system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] located within the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system was the location of an [[Airam (group)|Airam]] [[Hinda (Repair Yard)|repair yard]] that was attacked by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force ''Vengeance'']] during the the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="XWvTF:BoP" />
